ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-1,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District and M2-2, Light Industry District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 26-G in the area bound by:

West 105" Street; South Vincennes Avenue; a line 441 feet north of West 104" Street;
the east line of Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad; the east line of Pittsburgh,
Cincinnati, Chicago and St. Louis Railroad; a line 185 feet north of and parallel to West
105" Street; the alley next east of an parallel to South Throop Street; the east line of
Pittsburgh, Cincinnati, Chicago and St. Louis Railroad,

to those of a B1-1, Neighborhood Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
